_comment: USD per 1M tokens. GitHub Copilot bills AI Credits (1 credit = $0.01) at each model's API rate since 2026-06-01. Verify against docs.github.com > Copilot > Models and pricing and update if they change.
currency_note: Costs are reported in USD and AI Credits.

assumptions._note: Agent loops resend the whole context on every tool call. Input per unit ~= calls * (base + 0.5 * work_tokens); 75% of that is assumed to be cache reads.

legacy_premium_requests._note: Only if your org is still on request-based billing: set enabled=true and fill multipliers from GitHub docs. cost.py then also reports premium requests (calls * multiplier).
